sources_used: Arcade Maps scrapers/ziv.py + README (GH/ITG/Beat Saber/StepMania map to other)

findings.name: The 1up Arcade Bar - Colfax
findings.evidence_quote: Official Colfax Games list includes Guitar Hero Arcade among retro cabs.
findings.note: GH Arcade maps to other per project classification (not a named Bemani/SMX layer). ZIv also lists GH in Pinball Room; visitor comment ~1 month ago. No DDR/PIU/SMX found.

findings.name: The 1up Arcade Bar - Greenwood Village
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade (International), condition Perfect, price US$1.00.
findings.note: Sister 1up location; only rhythm cab on ZIv is GH Arcade (other). Venue open per chain site; no official Greenwood games page checked with GH line.

findings.name: The Alley at Southshore
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: StepMania Converted Cabinet. Location: To the left of the entrance, in the back. Comment: Pad needs some cleaning but is pretty...
findings.note: StepMania converted cab maps to other (not StepManiaX). Venue open as bowling/arcade complex (thealleyatsouthshore.com, 2026).

findings.name: The Arcade
findings.evidence_quote: StepMania Converted Cabinet. Comment: Running ITGMania with Simply Love. Has 7500 songs. Fail set is off. Pads seem to be showing degradation as of Jan 2026 and should be mentioned to staff.
findings.note: Longview Mall arcade still listed open 2025-2026 guides. ITGMania/StepMania convert = other. Pad wear note Jan 2026.

findings.name: The Castle Fun Center
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Beat Saber Arcade (Perfect) - Stand-alone dedicated Beat Saber cab. Headset and controllers will lower upon card swipe. Guitar Hero Arcade (Great) - P1 guitar is absolutely flawless...
findings.note: GH + Beat Saber both map to other. Visitor comment 'that ddr machine is mine now' implies former DDR SuperNOVA removed; not listing ddr.

findings.name: The Claridge Arcade
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade. Comment: P1 guitar frets are very mushy, have no bounceback, and sink below the fretboard.
findings.note: Atlantic City hotel arcade; ZIv lists GH only. Freshness of cab presence not independently confirmed 2025-2026.

findings.name: The Clubhouse at Hackers [No DDR/PIU/SMX]
findings.evidence_quote: There are NO DDR, Pump It Up, or StepmaniaX here. Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade near the center of the arcade.
findings.note: Positive no DDR/PIU/SMX, but GH Arcade present (other). Name tag is accurate for major dance cabs only.

findings.name: The Coin Jam
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade, US$1.00 for 1 song, condition Moderate.
findings.note: Salem OR barcade; only music cab GH (other).

findings.name: The Coliseum
findings.evidence_quote: Guitar Hero Arcade comment: 2 cabs side by side. In the Groove 2 upstairs back room (ITG-Coliseum-Dec-2025 photo). Insert Coin also lists Guitar Hero Arcade and In The Groove 2.
findings.note: GH + ITG2 both other. ZIv states 2 GH cabs; omit precise game_counts because ITG is a third other cab without a stated count. Visitors ~6 months ago.

findings.name: The Reboot Social
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade, condition Unknown.
findings.note: Eau Claire WI; ZIv only GH, no recent visitor corroboration found.

findings.name: The Underground Arcade
findings.evidence_quote: Guitar Hero Arcade near back (Great). In the Groove: Far back corner. Comment: Its a DDR Conversion Cab not a Dedicab, All sensors have been replaced...
findings.note: Black Oak Casino family floor. ITG is DDR-conversion hardware running ITG (other), not official ddr cab.

findings.name: The Vault
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade, location second floor, condition Great, 6 credits.
findings.note: Auburn CA visitthevault.com; GH only on ZIv music list.

findings.name: Tiebreakers
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade. Comment: Comes with chairs to sit on while playing; Left guitar is missing its strap. 6 Credits / 1 Song.
findings.note: Johnson City TN family entertainment; GH only among tracked music games.

findings.name: Tiki Action Park
findings.evidence_quote: Guitar Hero Arcade. In the Groove 2 to the right of the main entrance. Comment: R21 & default theme, USB customs enabled. Timer disabled. P2 gen...
findings.note: Centereach NY; GH + ITG2 = other. No official DDR/SMX listed.

findings.name: Tinseltown USA
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade, US$1.00 for 1 song, condition Moderate. Insert Coin lists Guitar Hero Arcade at Cinemark Tinseltown Colorado Springs and XD (1545 Cheyenne Mountain Blvd).
findings.note: Cinemark theater still open 2026; GH is lobby arcade type. Age of cab condition unknown.

findings.name: Tri-Cities Flea Market
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: ITGmania. Comment: Right Side is better than left. Has DDR Songs with cursed converted songs. Doubles limited to PUMP songs. Song list notes Running on Pump mode; 4436 songs.
findings.note: ITGmania (StepMania fork) = other, not stepmaniax and not pump_it_up. Photo titles say Pump it Up Prime upgrade but machine row is ITGmania; do not attach PIU slug. Visitors as recent as ~23 days ago. Sat-Sun flea market hours only.

findings.name: Triple Crown Sports
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade in the game room, US$1.00 for 3 songs, condition Perfect.
findings.note: Chillicothe OH; no independent recent confirmation beyond ZIv GH listing.

findings.name: US Golf & Games
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade, US$0.75 for 1 song, condition Perfect.
findings.note: Houston TX usgolfandgames.com; GH only among music games on ZIv.

findings.name: Velocity Esports (Former Gameworks Cincinnati)
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game section lists only Guitar Hero Arcade. Location: In front of DDR. Ticket redemption side. Comment: Works.did not play it but looked fine. Older visitor: DDR Extreme's P1 side buttons work fine... (15 years ago).
findings.note: Do NOT list ddr: DDR is only a location landmark / 15-year-old comment, not a current Music Game row. Former Gameworks at Newport on the Levee; cab inventory may have changed under Velocity. GH only = other.

findings.name: Wahooz Family Fun Zone
findings.evidence_quote: 1/18/2019 update: The Pump it Up machine has been sold to a local rhythm game enthusiast. Music Game remaining: Guitar Hero Arcade towards the back near the video...
findings.note: PIU sold 2019; only GH remains on music list (other). GH presence age not reconfirmed 2025-2026.

findings.name: Walmart
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade. Location: In the front area after you go through check-outs. Comment: An additional $.50 for premium songs.
findings.note: Hayden ID Walmart entry arcade; retail GH placements often rotate out. Treat as unverified current presence.

findings.name: Waterville USA
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade near Amusement Park ticket booth, condition Great, $2.00 Premium Songs.
findings.note: Gulf Shores AL water park; seasonal. GH = other.

findings.name: Wilderness Hotel - Northern Lights Arcade
findings.evidence_quote: NOTICE: The Pump It Up Pro FX cabinet is confirmed to be missing from this location by resort arcade staff. Music Game still listed: Guitar Hero Arcade by Wheel Deal (Great). Visitor: I did not see the Guitar Hero, or really any of the listed games... rearranged everything ~1-2 years ago.
findings.note: PIU confirmed gone. GH still on ZIv but visitor report did not find it after resort rearrange; confidence unverified. No ddr/piu.

findings.name: Wonderland
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade behind the Terminator machine near front entrance, US$0.50 for 1 song, condition Unknown.
findings.note: Spokane Wonderland USA; GH only, condition unknown, no recent third-party confirm.

findings.name: YESTERcades (Somerville)
findings.evidence_quote: Guitar Hero Arcade Free Play Perfect. In the Groove 2 visible from outside next to window. Comment: In The Groove 3 marquee & theme. Pad panels are recessed and not flush with the corner brackets...
findings.note: Venue open per yestercades.com/somerville/ 2026 hours. GH + ITG2 = other. Visitor ~8 months ago.

findings.name: mDaWg's House
findings.evidence_quote: In the Groove 2. Location: My garage. Comment: Contact me, don't just show up. Mike Calfin on facebook... ITG2 Dedicab is in 100% perfect working order. Hours Mon-Sun closed.
findings.note: Private residence/garage collection, not a public arcade. Appointment only. ZIv comments ~15 years stale; cab may still exist but unconfirmed. ITG = other.

findings.name: Incredible Pizza Co
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade. Comment: Left controller red button must be pressed hard or doesn't register. Right controller blue button is bad.
findings.note: Springfield MO; visitor note PiU is no longer there. Only GH remains on list.

findings.name: Peter Piper Pizza
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game machine list: Guitar Hero Arcade US$1.00 Great. Information text historically said In the Groove 2 dedicab then EDIT: I checked and this was NOT hacked...
findings.note: Only GH on machine list. Info-field ITG2 claim is contradictory/historical; do not add ITG or ddr without a machine row.

findings.name: Yakima Family Fun Center
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade near the front doors. Comment: A bit hard to press the fret buttons down on the player 1 guitar.
findings.note: yakima-family-fun.com; GH = other only.

findings.name: Indoor Karting Montevideo
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv API lastUpdateTime 2026-01-24: Dance Dance Revolution EXTREME cond 1. Comment: Out of order. Possible sys573 failure, as lights for the marquee work, and the image is displaying a Disconnect screen.
findings.note: DDR EXTREME present but out of order as of 2026-01-24. Still has_games ddr with OOO caveat; not closed.

findings.name: Kids Mania Entretenimientos
findings.evidence_quote: lastUpdateTime 2026-01-26: StepMania Converted Cabinet. Comment: Similar to the one in Costa Azul, but it keeps the original decals. DDR 3rd Mix running SM3.9 with default theme and pop...
findings.note: StepMania 3.9 on DDR 3rd Mix shell = other (not official ddr online, not stepmaniax). La Floresta, Canelones UY.

findings.name: Maquinitas de Costa Azul
findings.evidence_quote: lastUpdateTime 2026-01-26: StepMania Converted Cabinet cond 4. Comment: DDR 3rd Mix, andando software Stepmania 3.9, con pack de canciones pop latinas e internacionales. Monitor CRT reemplazad...
findings.note: Same pattern as Kids Mania: SM3.9 convert = other. Opens ~18:00 per ZIv info.

findings.name: Mercado Agrícola de Montevideo (maM)
findings.evidence_quote: lastUpdateTime 2025-10-22 machines: Off Road Challenge (2P), Hot Flash. No Music Game entries.
findings.note: ZIv lists only racing/redemption; silence is not confirmed_none. No web evidence of rhythm cabs found.

findings.name: Mundo Cartoon - Nuevocentro Shopping
findings.evidence_quote: lastUpdateTime 2026-01-30: Bigfoot MAYHEM, Dead Heat, Storm Racer G, Super Bikes 2, Jurassic Park Arcade, Rabbids Hollywood, Terminator Salvation. No music/rhythm machines.
findings.note: Family mall arcade; empty music list without positive no-rhythm attestation = unknown.

findings.name: Play Time - Portones Shopping
findings.evidence_quote: lastUpdateTime 2024-08-20: Batman, Cruis'n Blast, Daytona Championship USA, Daytona USA, NFS Carbon, Nirin, Super Bikes 2, Jurassic Park, Let's Go Jungle, Terminator, Stacker, Arm Champs II. No Music Game rows.
findings.note: Stale 2024 list; no rhythm games listed and none found on web. unknown not confirmed_none.

findings.name: Playland Costa Urbana
findings.evidence_quote: lastUpdateTime 2026-02-16: Jambo Safari, Lethal Weapon 3, Star Wars Episode I, Daytona USA, Silent Scope 2, Star Wars Trilogy, House of the Dead 2, Virtua Striker 2. No music games.
findings.note: Shooter/racing inventory only on ZIv. No positive no-rhythm statement.

findings.name: Punta Shopping
findings.evidence_quote: lastUpdateTime 2025-02-14: Dance Central 3 cond 5 (Perfect).
findings.note: Dance Central 3 (Kinect dance cab) maps to other. Not a Bemani pad game. Punta del Este mall.

findings.name: C.C. Costa Azul (Full Diversión)
findings.evidence_quote: lastUpdateTime 2016-12-30: Daytona USA (2P), Manx TT Superbike x2. No music games. Data is ~9 years old.
findings.note: Coro, Falcon VE. Extremely stale ZIv; cannot confirm open or games. unknown.

findings.name: Guardians e-Sports | Arena Gamer
findings.evidence_quote: lastUpdateTime 2025-09-29: Project OutFox Converted Cabinet cond 4. Comment: @frente.dancingstage en instagram para cualquier petición. ZIv picture titled Dance Dance Revolution (OutFox can run DDR packs).
findings.note: OutFox is a StepMania-family engine = other, not official ddr. Instagram @guardians.ez active into 2026 (Mother's Day posts, pista de baile). Maracaibo C.C. Metrosol.
